Project's HDFS UDF path

Task instance batch number of the instance generated
Task code of the task which refers to this variable
Instance code of the task instance which refers to this variable

Business time of the task instance.Business time is defined as the starting time of the task's frequency cycle.    If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM    For daily task the business time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00    For weekly task the business time is the Monday 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-05-31 00:00:00    For monthly task, the business time is 0AM of 1st day of the month of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-01 00:00:00    For hourly task, the business time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
Date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210603
Previous month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202105
Previous date of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMdd, e.g. 20210531
Previous hour of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMMddhh, e.g. 2021053109
Year of the current task instance business time, format yyyy, e.g. 2020
Month of the current task instance business time, format yyyyMM, e.g. 202005
Date of the current task instance business time, format dd, e.g. 30
Hour of the current task instance business time , format hh, eg: 18

The time of a day a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched. If now is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the scheduled time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the schedule time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd. The date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a scheduled task instance is supposed to be launched, format yyyyMMdd.

The time of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met. If the start run time is 3 June 2021, 09:30AM. For daily, weekly and monthly task, the start run time is 0AM of the task instance generation date, e.g. 2021-06-03 00:00:00 For hourly task, the start run time is the hourly start of the task instance generation time, e.g. 2021-06-03 09:00:00
The date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.
The previous date of a task instance starts running after all input dependencies are met, format yyyyMMdd.

--********************************************************************--
-- Author:              wei.tao@shopee.com
-- Created Time:        2025-08-20
-- Theme Domain：       Anti-fraud 日志数据策略feature - dws 层
-- Description:         https://jira.shopee.io/browse/SPFDT-54753
-- Data Granularity:    
-- Change Log:
--********************************************************************--

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_long_agg_feature_trx_di;
CREATE TABLE risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_long_agg_feature_trx_di (
    flow_no STRING COMMENT '流水号',

    -- 请求用户数特征（req系列）
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_30d BIGINT COMMENT '近30天内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_60d BIGINT COMMENT '近60天内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_90d BIGINT COMMENT '近90天内的不同用户注册请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_180d BIGINT COMMENT '近180天内的不同用户注册请求数',

    -- 激活用户数特征（act系列）
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_30d BIGINT COMMENT '近30天内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_60d BIGINT COMMENT '近60天内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_90d BIGINT COMMENT '近90天内的不同用户注册激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_180d BIGINT COMMENT '近180天内的不同用户注册激活数',

    -- 批量注册请求用户数特征（req_batch系列）
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_30d BIGINT COMMENT '近30天内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_60d BIGINT COMMENT '近60天内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_90d BIGINT COMMENT '近90天内的不同批量注册用户请求数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_180d BIGINT COMMENT '近180天内的不同批量注册用户请求数',

    -- 批量注册激活用户数特征（trx_batch系列）
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_30d BIGINT COMMENT '近30天内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_60d BIGINT COMMENT '近60天内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_90d BIGINT COMMENT '近90天内的不同批量注册用户激活数',
    gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_180d BIGINT COMMENT '近180天内的不同批量注册用户激活数'
)
COMMENT 'risk mart summary table'
PARTITIONED BY (
   grass_date STRING
)
STORED AS parquet
tblproperties
(
    "orc.compress" = "zstd"
)
location '${HDFS_PATH}/dwd/dws_risk_reg_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_long_agg_feature_trx_di/grass_region=${grass_region}';


CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW 
gpshex${n}_hist_all_middle_day_agg_part as (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        app_id, scene_id, gpshex${n}, platform_user_id,
        end_result, is_batch_registration, is_reactivate,
        grass_date  -- 保留日期用于后续筛选
    FROM risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshexn_trx_di
    WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date('${ds}') - interval '29' day AND date('${ds}') - interval '1' day
);

CACHE TABLE gpshex${n}_hist_all_middle_day_agg_part;   -- 把查询结果缓存到内存/磁盘
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW 
gpshex${n}_hist_all_edge_day_agg_part as (
    SELECT DISTINCT 
        app_id, scene_id, gpshex${n}, platform_user_id,
        req_time, end_result, is_batch_registration, is_reactivate
    FROM risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshexn_trx_di
    WHERE grass_date in (date('${ds}'),date('${ds}') - interval '30' day)
);
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW 
has_reactivate as (
SELECT 
    base.flow_no,

    -- ==================== 请求用户数特征 (req系列) ====================
    
    -- 30天请求用户数
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN platform_user_id != hist_all_platform_user_id
                AND hist_all_grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '29' day
            THEN hist_all_platform_user_id
            WHEN platform_user_id != today_platform_user_id
                AND req_time - today_req_time <= 2592000  -- 30天 = 2592000秒
            THEN today_platform_user_id
        END
    ) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_30d,
    
    -- 60天请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_60d,
    
    -- 90天请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_90d,
    
    -- 180天请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_180d,
    
    -- ==================== 激活用户数特征 (act系列) ====================
    
    -- 30天激活用户数
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN platform_user_id != hist_all_platform_user_id
                AND hist_all_grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '29' day
                AND hist_end_result = 'pass'
            THEN hist_all_platform_user_id
            WHEN platform_user_id != today_platform_user_id
                AND req_time - today_req_time <= 2592000  -- 30天 = 2592000秒
                AND hist_end_result = 'pass'
            THEN today_platform_user_id
        END
    ) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_30d,
    
    -- 60天激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_60d,
    
    -- 90天激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_90d,
    
    -- 180天激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_180d,
    
    -- ==================== 批量注册请求用户数特征 (batch req系列) ====================
    
    -- 30天批量注册请求用户数
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN platform_user_id != hist_all_platform_user_id
                AND hist_all_grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '29' day
                AND hist_is_batch_registration = 1
            THEN hist_all_platform_user_id
            WHEN platform_user_id != today_platform_user_id
                AND req_time - today_req_time <= 2592000  -- 30天 = 2592000秒
                AND hist_is_batch_registration = 1
            THEN today_platform_user_id
        END
    ) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_30d,
    
    -- 60天批量注册请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_60d,
    
    -- 90天批量注册请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_90d,
    
    -- 180天批量注册请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_180d,
    
    -- ==================== 批量注册激活用户数特征 (trx_batch系列) ====================
    
    -- 30天批量注册激活用户数
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN platform_user_id != hist_all_platform_user_id
                AND hist_all_grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '29' day
                AND hist_end_result = 'pass'
                AND hist_is_batch_registration = 1
            THEN hist_all_platform_user_id
            WHEN platform_user_id != today_platform_user_id
                AND req_time - today_req_time <= 2592000  -- 30天 = 2592000秒
                AND hist_end_result = 'pass'
                AND hist_is_batch_registration = 1
            THEN today_platform_user_id
        END
    ) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_30d,
    
    -- 60天批量注册激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_60d,
    
    -- 90天批量注册激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_90d,
    
    -- 180天批量注册激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_180d
        
FROM 
(
select base.*, hist_all.platform_user_id as hist_all_platform_user_id, null as today_platform_user_id,
        hist_all.grass_date as hist_all_grass_date, null as today_req_time, hist_all.end_result as hist_end_result, hist_all.is_batch_registration as hist_is_batch_registration--, hist_all.is_reactivate
from 
(
    select distinct flow_no,platform_user_id,req_time, app_id, scene_id,gpshex${n},grass_date
    from risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di base
    where base.grass_date = '${ds}'
        AND base.app_id not in ('kredit', 'spj', 'spjup') -- bcl/spl/scl
) base
LEFT JOIN gpshex${n}_hist_all_middle_day_agg_part hist_all
    ON md5(base.gpshex${n}) = md5(hist_all.gpshex${n})
    AND base.app_id = hist_all.app_id
    AND base.scene_id = hist_all.scene_id
UNION ALL 
select base.*, null as hist_all_platform_user_id, today.platform_user_id as today_platform_user_id,
        null as hist_all_grass_date, today.req_time as today_req_time, today.end_result as hist_end_result, today.is_batch_registration as hist_is_batch_registration--, today.is_reactivate
from
(
    select distinct flow_no,platform_user_id,req_time, app_id, scene_id,gpshex${n},grass_date
    from risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di base
    where base.grass_date = '${ds}'
        AND base.app_id not in ('kredit', 'spj', 'spjup') -- bcl/spl/scl
) base
LEFT JOIN gpshex${n}_hist_all_edge_day_agg_part today
    ON md5(base.gpshex${n}) = md5(today.gpshex${n})
    AND base.app_id = today.app_id
    AND base.scene_id = today.scene_id   
) as base
GROUP BY     
    base.flow_no
);
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW 
no_reactivate as ( 
SELECT
    base.flow_no,

    -- ==================== 请求用户数特征 (req系列) ====================
    
    -- 30天请求用户数
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN platform_user_id != hist_all_platform_user_id
                AND hist_all_grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '29' day
            THEN hist_all_platform_user_id
            WHEN platform_user_id != today_platform_user_id
                AND req_time - today_req_time <= 2592000  -- 30天 = 2592000秒
            THEN today_platform_user_id
        END
    ) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_30d,
    
    -- 60天请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_60d,
    
    -- 90天请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_90d,
    
    -- 180天请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_180d,
    
    -- ==================== 激活用户数特征 (act系列) ====================
    
    -- 30天激活用户数
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN platform_user_id != hist_all_platform_user_id

            THEN hist_all_platform_user_id
            WHEN platform_user_id != today_platform_user_id
                AND req_time - today_req_time <= 2592000  -- 30天 = 2592000秒
                AND hist_end_result = 'pass'
            THEN today_platform_user_id
        END
    ) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_30d,
    
    -- 60天激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_60d,
    
    -- 90天激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_90d,
    
    -- 180天激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_180d,
    
    -- ==================== 批量注册请求用户数特征 (batch req系列) ====================
    
    -- 30天批量注册请求用户数
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN platform_user_id != hist_all_platform_user_id
                AND hist_all_grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '29' day
                AND hist_is_batch_registration = 1
            THEN hist_all_platform_user_id
            WHEN platform_user_id != today_platform_user_id
                AND req_time - today_req_time <= 2592000  -- 30天 = 2592000秒
                AND hist_is_batch_registration = 1
            THEN today_platform_user_id
        END
    ) AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_30d,
    
    -- 60天批量注册请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_60d,
    
    -- 90天批量注册请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_90d,
    
    -- 180天批量注册请求用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_180d,
    
    -- ==================== 批量注册激活用户数特征 (trx_batch系列) ====================
    
    -- 30天批量注册激活用户数
    COUNT(DISTINCT 
        CASE 
            WHEN platform_user_id != hist_all_platform_user_id
                AND hist_all_grass_date >= date('${ds}') - interval '29' day
                AND hist_end_result = 'pass'
                AND hist_is_batch_registration = 1
            THEN hist_all_platform_user_id
            WHEN platform_user_id != today_platform_user_id
                AND req_time - today_req_time <= 2592000  -- 30天 = 2592000秒
                AND hist_end_result = 'pass'
                AND hist_is_batch_registration = 1
            THEN today_platform_user_id
        END
    ) AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_30d,
    
    -- 60天批量注册激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_60d,
    
    -- 90天批量注册激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_90d,
    
    -- 180天批量注册激活用户数
    null AS gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_180d
FROM 
(
select base.*, hist_all.platform_user_id as hist_all_platform_user_id, null as today_platform_user_id,
        hist_all.grass_date as hist_all_grass_date, null as today_req_time, hist_all.end_result as hist_end_result, hist_all.is_batch_registration as hist_is_batch_registration--, hist_all.is_reactivate
from 
(
    select distinct flow_no,platform_user_id,req_time, app_id, scene_id,gpshex${n},grass_date
    from risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di base
    where base.grass_date = '${ds}'
        AND base.app_id in ('kredit', 'spj', 'spjup') -- bcl/spl/scl
) base
LEFT JOIN gpshex${n}_hist_all_middle_day_agg_part hist_all
    ON md5(base.gpshex${n}) = md5(hist_all.gpshex${n})
    AND if(base.app_id = 'kredit', base.app_id = hist_all.app_id, base.app_id = hist_all.app_id AND base.scene_id = hist_all.scene_id)
WHERE hist_all.is_reactivate = 0
UNION ALL 
select base.*, null as hist_all_platform_user_id, today.platform_user_id as today_platform_user_id,
        null as hist_all_grass_date, today.req_time as today_req_time, today.end_result as hist_end_result, today.is_batch_registration as hist_is_batch_registration--, today.is_reactivate
from
(
    select distinct flow_no,platform_user_id,req_time, app_id, scene_id,gpshex${n},grass_date
    from risk_report.dwd_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_feature_trx_base_di base
    where base.grass_date = '${ds}'
        AND base.app_id in ('kredit', 'spj', 'spjup') -- bcl/spl/scl
) base
LEFT JOIN gpshex${n}_hist_all_edge_day_agg_part today
    ON md5(base.gpshex${n}) = md5(today.gpshex${n})
    AND if(base.app_id = 'kredit', base.app_id = today.app_id, base.app_id = today.app_id AND base.scene_id = today.scene_id) 
WHERE today.is_reactivate = 0
) as base 
GROUP BY 
    base.flow_no
);

insert overwrite table risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_long_agg_feature_trx_di partition (grass_date = '${ds}')
SELECT *
FROM has_reactivate
WHERE gpshex${n}_reg_req_30d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_trx_30d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_30d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_30d > 0
union all
SELECT *
FROM no_reactivate
WHERE gpshex${n}_reg_req_30d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_trx_30d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_req_batch_30d > 0 OR gpshex${n}_reg_trx_batch_30d > 0
;



msck repair table risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_long_agg_feature_trx_di;
refresh table risk_report.dws_risk_${reg}_group_fraud_gpshex${n}_long_agg_feature_trx_di;
